statement: Written global deduplication argument for the fixed c4 successor over fields of characteristic not2,3,5: first elliptic projection n R f* equals tau phi[2], with tau(X,V)=(X/100+1/125,-V/1000). Supported by seven cleared ring lemmas, explicit base-image2-torsion correction and cited Picard/correspondence geometry. Geometry is a written argument, not a Lean construction; finite four-field controls pass. Scope excludes the final Jacobian-valued two-hop map. Unsigned; no measured advantage.
